summary: Historical Invoice Import + AI Pricing Analysis testing completed (iteration 56). All 15 backend API tests passed covering: file upload (CSV, XLSX, PDF), tenant-scoped import sessions, field mapping, AI analysis with confidence levels, Accept/Edit/Ignore review workflow, and benchmark-only saves. Frontend UI testing passed: PricingSetup page loads at /settings/pricing-setup, navigation from Company Settings works, upload card displays, import history list shows existing sessions, field mapping review with all 5 fields works, suggestions review card displays with confidence levels. No regression on /pricing-calculator/settings page. Selling Price Benchmarks remain separate from Cost Settings as designed.

GET /api/pricing-setup/imports.description: Returns tenant-scoped list of import sessions

POST /api/pricing-setup/imports (CSV upl.description: Creates import session with CSV file, returns file metadata, preview columns, mapping suggestions

GET /api/pricing-setup/imports/{id}.description: Returns specific tenant-scoped import with files, mapping, normalized_rows, status

PUT /api/pricing-setup/imports/{id}/mapp.description: Saves field mapping (description_field, quantity_field, total_field, dimension_field, category_field, category_overrides), builds normalized rows

POST /api/pricing-setup/imports/{id}/ana.description: Runs AI analysis using GPT-5.2, returns suggestions with confidence levels (High/Medium/Low), analysis_summary with invoice_count, line_item_count, categories_detected

POST /api/pricing-setup/imports/{id}/rev.description: Processes decisions array with suggestion_id, status (accepted/ignored/edited), final_value. Saves to selling_price_benchmarks ONLY

Tenant isolation.description: Imports are tenant-scoped, fake import ID returns 404, admin/owner access required

Benchmarks separate from Cost Settings.description: selling_price_benchmarks updated by review, category_defaults (cost settings) remain unchanged

No regression on /pricing-calculator/set.description: GET/PUT /api/pricing/defaults still works, pricing calculator still functional

Confidence levels in suggestions.description: All suggestions have valid confidence (High/Medium/Low) based on sample_count and complete_samples

Category override mapping.description: category_overrides in mapping payload correctly override category_final for specific descriptions

Frontend /settings/pricing-setup page lo.description: Page loads with data-testid='pricing-setup-page', two tabs (Pricing & Cost Settings, Historical Invoice Import)

Frontend upload workflow UI.description: Upload card, file input (CSV/XLSX/PDF), upload button all present and functional

Frontend import history list.description: Import sessions displayed with file count, status badge, created date. Clickable to load details

Frontend field mapping UI.description: 5 field mapping dropdowns (Description, Quantity, Total, Dimension, Category) with columns from uploaded files

Frontend suggestions review UI.description: Suggestions card shows category_label, benchmark_field, suggested_value, confidence badge, Accept/Ignore buttons

Navigation Settings > Pricing Setup.description: Accessible via Company Settings card and Settings sub-navigation

critical_code_review_comments: pricing_setup.py routes use tenant_id from current_user for all queries ensuring tenant isolation
ensure_admin_access() helper checks user.role in ['owner', 'admin'] before allowing import management
ai_analyze_category_metrics() uses GPT-5.2 via emergentintegrations with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY
calculate_confidence() returns High/Medium/Low based on sample_count >= 12 and complete_samples >= 8 thresholds
review endpoint writes only to selling_price_benchmarks collection, not pricing_configuration cost fields
normalize_structured_rows() uses pandas to parse CSV/XLSX, ai_extract_pdf_rows() uses GPT-5.2 for PDF text extraction
Frontend PricingSetup.js properly handles all import states (mapping_required, ready_for_analysis, analyzed, reviewed)
File upload accepts .pdf, .csv, .xlsx, .xls extensions with proper MIME type handling

success_rate.backend: 100% - All 15 pricing setup API tests passed
success_rate.frontend: 100% - PricingSetup page loads, all UI elements functional, navigation working

context_for_next_testing_agent: Historical Invoice Import + AI Pricing Analysis feature fully implemented and tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/pricing-setup/imports (file upload), PUT .../mapping (field mapping), POST .../analyze (AI analysis with GPT-5.2), POST .../review (Accept/Edit/Ignore to selling_price_benchmarks). Frontend page at /settings/pricing-setup has 2 tabs: Pricing & Cost Settings (links to /pricing-calculator/settings) and Historical Invoice Import (main workflow).
